beings.name: Wilbur
beings.hint: Whippoorwills scream outside, waiting for a soul to slip free.

beings.name: Mi-Go
beings.hint: Spores drift down like grey snow, and a buzzing comes from beyond the stars.

beings.name: Ithaqua
beings.hint: The air turns bitterly cold, then searing.

beings.name: Abhoth
beings.hint: Something wet and formless slaps against the veil.

beings.name: Mother Hydra
beings.hint: A stench of brine and rotting kelp seeps through.

beings.name: Hound of Tindalos
beings.hint: Every corner in the room sharpens. Time stutters.

beings.name: Dunwich Horror
beings.hint: Whippoorwills scream outside, waiting for a soul to slip free.

beings.name: Haunter of the Dark
beings.hint: Incense and chanting, and the candle flames all lean the same way.

beings.name: Dagon
beings.hint: A stench of brine and rotting kelp seeps through.

beings.name: Mh'ithrha
beings.hint: Thin, monotonous fluting from the centre of everything.

beings.name: Azathoth
beings.hint: Thin, monotonous fluting from the centre of everything.

families.label: Deep Ones
families.lordLine: The Gate of Y'ha-nthlei grinds open. Mother Hydra rises from the black water, vast as a ship, and every Deep One in the hall starts to sing.

foes.name: a priest of the Esoteric Order of Dagon
a Deep One sentinel
foes.line: Gills flare in the green dark. A Deep One sentinel lowers its trident across the flooded hall.

foes.name: a brood of Dagon
foes.line: The water boils with small bodies. A brood of Dagon, half-grown and wholly vicious, swarms toward a delver.

foes.name: a Marsh in the old regalia
foes.line: Gold glints on scaled skin: a Marsh in the old regalia, more fish than man, bars the way with a ceremonial knife.

families.label: Star-spawn
families.lordLine: Coral heaves aside and Zoth-Ommog, risen, uncoils from the sunken temple, tentacled head the size of a church.

foes.name: a mad sailor of the Alert
foes.line: A sailor in a rotted pea-coat stumbles out of the fog, raving about a city of wrong angles. The mad sailor of the Alert grabs a delver by the collar.

foes.name: a dreamer touched by R'lyeh
foes.line: An artist sleepwalks toward a delver, clay still under his nails, sculpting something green and winged out of the air. A dreamer touched by R'lyeh, and he's not alone in his head.

foes.name: a sea-shoggoth
foes.line: The hall's far wall is not a wall. A sea-shoggoth bubbles toward a delver, eyes forming and bursting on its surface.

families.label: Ghouls
families.lordLine: The bone doors swing open. The Ghoul King sits on a throne of skulls, gnawing a femur, and points it at a delver.

foes.name: a Ghoul elder of the warrens
foes.line: Deep in the warrens, something old and grey unfolds from a nest of bones. A Ghoul elder, too ancient to walk upright, sniffs at a delver and smiles.

foes.name: a ghoul scavenger of Pnath
foes.line: A ghoul scavenger of Pnath meeps from the bone pile, then decides a delver looks fresher than anything else down here.

families.label: Mi-Go
families.lordLine: Cylinders line the vault, each holding a brain. The Mi-Go Overseer buzzes down from its scaffolding, surgical tools unfolding.

families.label: Hounds of Tindalos
families.lordLine: Every corner of the vault points inward. The First Hound of Tindalos pours out of the sharpest angle, tongue first.

foes.name: a member of the Great Race of Yith
a time-lost wanderer
foes.line: A man in clothes from three different centuries flickers into the corridor. The time-lost wanderer stares at a delver and screams 'NOT AGAIN'.

families.label: Shoggoths
families.lordLine: The vault wall breathes. It isn't a wall. The Primordial Shoggoth opens a thousand eyes and starts to pipe 'Tekeli-li'.

foes.name: a Shoggoth spawnling
foes.line: A puddle of black jelly sprouts a dozen eyes and a tiny, piping 'tekeli-li'. A Shoggoth spawnling has found a delver, and it's hungry.

foes.name: a thawed Elder Thing specimen
foes.line: A crate from the Miskatonic expedition has been opened from the inside. The thawed Elder Thing specimen unfolds its star-shaped head toward a delver.

families.label: Cultists
families.lord: the High Priest of the Starry Wisdom
families.lordLine: Incense chokes the vault. The High Priest of the Starry Wisdom raises the Shining Trapezohedron, and the dark leans in.

families.label: Sorcerers
families.lordLine: Salts hiss in their jars. Joseph Curwen, raised from his Saltes, steps out of the smoke, very much alive and very rude about it.

families.label: Dreamlands
families.lord: the High Priest Not to Be Described
families.lordLine: In the monastery on Leng, the High Priest Not to Be Described sits on a golden throne, yellow silk mask hanging over whatever is under it.

foes.name: a priest of the windowless monastery
foes.line: A figure in yellow silk drifts out of the windowless monastery. A priest of it, masked, and it does not walk so much as glide toward a delver.

families.label: The Yellow Court
families.lordLine: The vault is a stage. The Phantom of Truth stands at its centre, Pallid Mask and tattered yellow, and the play begins.

foes.name: an actor in The King in Yellow
foes.line: A troupe has been rehearsing the second act. An actor in The King in Yellow turns from the stage, and his mask isn't a mask.

foes.name: the Stranger in the Pallid Mask
foes.line: A figure in tattered yellow stands at the end of the hall. 'You may remove your mask now,' says a delver. The Stranger in the Pallid Mask says nothing. There is no mask.

families.label: The Black Goat
families.lord: the Eldest of the Dark Young
families.lordLine: A forest grows inside the vault. The Eldest of the Dark Young lifts itself on hoofed legs, tentacles weeping black sap.

foes.name: a cultist of the Black Goat
a Dark Young sapling
foes.line: A tree that wasn't there a moment ago bleats. A Dark Young sapling, all hooves and puckered mouths, toddles toward a delver.

families.label: Flame and Frost
families.lordLine: The gate melts. Fthaggua, lord of the Fire Vampires, blazes in the vault, a living sun with a thousand sparks orbiting it.

foes.name: a Flame Creature of Cthugha
foes.line: The torches flare white. A Flame Creature of Cthugha pours out of the brazier, and the stone under it starts to glow.

foes.name: a Child of Ithaqua
foes.line: The wind drops to nothing, then howls. A Child of Ithaqua stalks out of the snow, frost forming wherever it looks.

families.label: Burrowers
families.lordLine: The floor of the vault splits. Shudde M'ell, the Burrower Beneath, rises from G'harne, tentacles chanting in a voice of grinding rock.

families.label: N'kai
families.lordLine: In black N'kai, something toad-shaped and hungry waits. Zvilpogghua, son of Tsathoggua, lifts its bat-eared head.

families.label: Severn Valley
families.lordLine: The lake in the vault ripples. Glaaki, the Lake-Dweller, surfaces, spines bristling, eyes on long stalks turning to a delver.

foes.name: a Servant of Glaaki
foes.line: A man shuffles out of the lake, skin grey and cracking. A Servant of Glaaki, the spine-hole still weeping in his chest.

foes.name: a Brichester occultist
foes.line: A Brichester occultist clutches a volume of the Revelations and recites something that makes the walls sweat.

families.label: The Outer Court
families.lordLine: Flute music from the centre of everything. The Daemon Piper of Azathoth's court steps out of the void, piping the song that keeps the Sultan asleep.

foes.name: a Servitor of the Outer Gods
a Mindless Piper
foes.line: Thin, monotonous fluting drifts out of the dark. A Mindless Piper plays on, and the notes start pulling at a delver's thoughts.

foes.name: a void-touched astronomer
foes.line: An astronomer stands at a telescope pointed straight down. The void-touched astronomer turns to a delver: 'It looked back.'

foes.name: Mh'ithrha
foes.line: The dark opens a hundred eyes at once. Mh'ithrha, servant of the court at the centre of everything, has noticed a delver.

foes.name: Lam
foes.line: A pale, swollen head with no mouth hangs in the void, looking down at a delver with ancient patience. Lam has come through.

families.label: The Underworld
families.lordLine: The vault opens on a pit as deep as a city. The Gug Elder climbs out of it, scarred and enormous, and the ghasts scatter.

foes.name: a ghast of Zin
foes.line: Something hops on its hind legs just beyond the lantern light, and a ghast of Zin shrieks at the glow.

foes.name: a pack of ghasts
foes.line: The vaults of Zin fill with coughing barks: a pack of ghasts has caught the scent of a delver.

foes.name: a Gug of the tower city
foes.line: A tower of black stone moves. No, an arm: a Gug of the tower city, its vertical mouth opening from crown to belly, reaches for a delver.

foes.name: a dhole in the bone-heaps
foes.line: The bone-heaps of Pnath shift and slither. A dhole rears out of them, slick and endless, and the lantern shows no end to it.

families.label: Orcs and Trolls
families.lordLine: War-drums. The Orc Warchief stands on a pile of shields, a banner of skin rippling above him, and points his axe at a delver.

foes.name: a goblin raiding party
foes.line: Torches, cackling and the clank of stolen pots. A goblin raiding party pours out of a side tunnel and spots a delver.

foes.name: an orc scout
foes.line: An orc scout sniffs the air, bares a tusk and grins. Meat's back on the menu, and the menu is a delver.

foes.name: a cave goblin archer
foes.line: An arrow thunks into the wall beside a delver's head. A cave goblin archer giggles from the dark and nocks another.

foes.name: a half-orc sellsword
foes.line: A half-orc sellsword cracks his knuckles. 'Someone paid me to wait here,' he tells a delver. 'Nothing personal.'

foes.name: a warg rider
foes.line: Snarling and the drum of paws. A warg rider charges out of the tunnel, and the warg looks hungrier than the rider.

foes.name: an Uruk berserker
foes.line: A white hand painted on its face, foaming at the mouth. An Uruk berserker comes screaming out of the dark at a delver.

foes.name: a cave troll
foes.line: Chains rattle, a drum booms. A cave troll stoops under the arch and swings its club at a delver.

foes.name: an orc shaman
foes.line: An orc shaman shakes a staff hung with skulls, and the war-drums answer. The dark fills with grunting.

foes.name: a hill troll swinging a tree trunk
foes.line: A whole tree comes through the wall. On the other end of it, a hill troll looks for whatever it just missed. That's a delver.

foes.name: a mountain troll king
foes.line: The ground shakes in a rhythm. A mountain troll king rises from his throne of crushed armour and points at a delver.

foes.name: a fire-whip demon of the deep mines
foes.line: Shadow and flame. A fire-whip demon of the deep mines spreads wings of smoke, and its whip cracks loud as thunder.

families.label: The Restless Dead
families.lordLine: Shouts of power echo. The Dragon Priest floats above its sarcophagus, mask gleaming, staff crackling.

foes.name: a draugr
foes.line: A coffin lid slides open. A draugr sits up, blue eyes burning, and reaches for its rusted axe.

foes.name: a barrow-wight
foes.line: A cold mist rolls over the mound, and a barrow-wight sings a song that makes a delver's hands go numb.

foes.name: a skeleton guard
foes.line: A skeleton guard clatters to attention, still loyal to a king a thousand years dead.

foes.name: a restless bandit ghost
foes.line: A restless bandit ghost flickers by the tomb entrance, still trying to rob people. It's trying to rob a delver.

foes.name: a Draugr Deathlord
foes.line: A voice from the throne shouts a word, and the word hits a delver like a wall. A Draugr Deathlord stands up.

foes.name: a Ringwraith
foes.line: A shriek that freezes blood. A Ringwraith glides out of the dark, hooded and empty, and it smells a delver's soul.

foes.name: a death knight
foes.line: Black plate, a cold blue rune-blade, a dead horse that still remembers how to charge. A death knight levels its sword at a delver.

foes.name: a barrow-queen's handmaiden
foes.line: A barrow-queen's handmaiden drifts down the passage, veil trailing, singing a lullaby for the dead.

foes.name: the Hollow King on his barrow-throne
foes.line: At the bottom of the deepest mound, the Hollow King on his barrow-throne lifts his crowned skull and speaks a delver's name.

foes.name: the wight-lord of the downs
foes.line: Every barrow on the downs opens at once. The wight-lord of the downs walks out of the fog, a ring on each finger.

families.label: Dragons
families.lordLine: The hoard heaves. The Ancient Wyrm, older than the mountain around it, opens one burning eye and speaks a delver's name.

foes.name: a wyvern whelp
foes.line: A wyvern whelp screeches from a ledge, tail stinger twitching. It's small. It's furious.

foes.name: a kobold pack
foes.line: Yipping and the clink of tiny spears. A kobold pack has decided a delver is threatening their dragon's stuff.

foes.name: a drake hatchling
foes.line: An egg cracks. A drake hatchling tumbles out, sneezes a spark and decides a delver is its mother. Then it bites.

foes.name: a frost dragon
foes.line: The cavern ices over. A frost dragon drops from the ceiling, wings shedding snow, and inhales.

foes.name: a blood dragon
foes.line: Red-scaled and scarred from a hundred fights, a blood dragon roars a word that shakes the walls.

foes.name: a wyvern matriarch
foes.line: The whelps scatter. Their mother has arrived. A wyvern matriarch fills the tunnel with wings and poison.

foes.name: an Elder Dragon
foes.line: The gold hoard breathes. Then it opens one eye. An Elder Dragon has been sleeping here since before the stars were named.

foes.name: a dragon out of the old songs
foes.line: Every song about it was true. A dragon out of the old songs lifts its head from the gold and speaks: 'Thief.'

families.label: Daedra
families.lordLine: An Oblivion gate tears open in the vault. The Dremora Valkynaz steps through in black armour and bows mockingly to a delver.

foes.name: a scamp
foes.line: A scamp pops out of a puff of brimstone, cackles and throws a fireball roughly in the direction of a delver.

foes.name: a clannfear
foes.line: Something like a lizard with a hatchet for a face screeches out of an Oblivion gate. A clannfear.

foes.name: a flame atronach
foes.line: A summoning circle flares and a flame atronach steps out, dancing and burning in equal measure.

foes.name: a dremora
foes.line: Black armour, red skin, a voice full of contempt. A dremora steps through the gate: 'Mortal. On your knees.'

foes.name: a daedroth
foes.line: A crocodile on two legs, breathing fire. A daedroth lumbers out of the gate and snaps at a delver.

foes.name: a spider daedra
foes.line: Half woman, half spider, entirely annoyed. A spider daedra skitters across the ceiling toward a delver.

foes.name: a storm atronach
foes.line: Floating rocks, crackling lightning. A storm atronach assembles itself out of the air and the floor.

foes.name: a Daedric Prince's avatar
foes.line: Reality tilts. A Daedric Prince's avatar steps into the mortal plane, curious what a delver is worth.

foes.name: a xivilai warlord
foes.line: A xivilai warlord ducks through the Oblivion gate, horned and scarred, dragging a greatsword behind it.

families.label: Beasts and Fey
families.lordLine: Howling from every direction. The Wolf Queen pads out of the moonlight, twice the size of any warg, crown of antlers on her head.

foes.name: a warg pack
foes.line: Howling all around. A warg pack slinks out of the trees and closes the circle around a delver.

foes.name: a spriggan
foes.line: A tree moves. A spriggan uncurls from the bark, glowing green, and the forest creatures turn to look at a delver.

foes.name: a will-o'-the-wisp
foes.line: A friendly little light bobs ahead of a delver, leading the way. It is not friendly. It is a will-o'-the-wisp.

foes.name: a werewolf
foes.line: The moon comes out. So does the werewolf, mid-transformation, bones cracking and very much looking at a delver.

foes.name: a hagraven
foes.line: Half crone, half crow, cackling over a pot. A hagraven looks up and decides a delver would fit in the pot.

foes.name: a corrupted tree-shepherd
foes.line: A tree-shepherd, old and slow and rotting from the inside, groans a long word at a delver. It isn't a friendly word.

foes.name: an ancient forest hag
foes.line: A cottage on chicken legs crashes through the trees. The ancient forest hag leans out the window: 'Dinner.'

foes.name: the Beast of the Deepwood
foes.line: Every bird goes quiet. The Beast of the Deepwood steps into the clearing, antlered, hungry and older than the trees.

foes.name: a treasure goblin
foes.line: A jingling, giggling little thing with a sack bigger than itself. A treasure goblin spots a delver, squeals and starts running.

foes.name: a pack of goblin pickpockets
foes.line: Tiny hands in every pocket. A pack of goblin pickpockets has already taken a delver's lunch and is going for the purse.

foes.name: a gem-gorged goblin
foes.line: A gem-gorged goblin waddles past, belly glittering with swallowed jewels. It burps a ruby. It sees a delver.

foes.name: a goblin dragging a sack bigger than itself
foes.line: A sack is moving down the corridor. Under it, somewhere, a goblin dragging a sack bigger than itself is very determined.

foes.name: a gilded goblin
foes.line: Plated in stolen gold from ear to toe, a gilded goblin glints in the torchlight and cackles at a delver.

foes.name: a goblin with a half-open portal
foes.line: A goblin is halfway into a swirling portal, sack first. It sees a delver, squeals, and starts pulling itself through faster.

foes.name: an odious collector
foes.line: An odious collector sorts a mountain of stolen trinkets by smell. It finds a delver on the list.

foes.name: a mimic chest
foes.line: A beautiful chest, gold-trimmed and unguarded. It has teeth. It's a mimic chest, and it's already open.

foes.name: a blood-thief goblin
foes.line: A blood-thief goblin licks its knife. It doesn't steal gold. It steals something else.

foes.name: a gold-swollen sire
foes.line: Something enormous and wobbling sits on a mountain of coins. A gold-swollen sire. Every time it moves, smaller goblins fall out.

foes.name: the goblin who stole a god's purse
foes.line: A tiny goblin is struggling under a purse that hums with divine power. The goblin who stole a god's purse sees a delver and panics.

horrors.name: the Xenomorph
horrors.line: Something drips from the ceiling. A long, eyeless head slides out of the dark above a delver.

horrors.name: the Xenomorph Praetorian
horrors.line: A huge crested Xenomorph shoves through the hive walls toward a delver. Its warriors scatter before it.

horrors.name: the Necromorph Slasher
horrors.line: A corpse in a mining suit lurches up, two long bone blades bursting from its shoulders.

horrors.name: the Hunter
horrors.line: A huge Necromorph shambles toward a delver, its limbs growing back as fast as they are cut.

horrors.name: Pyramid Head
horrors.line: An air raid siren wails. A towering figure in a rusted iron pyramid drags a great knife toward a delver.

horrors.name: the Thing
horrors.line: The dog in the kennel splits open, its body becoming tentacles and teeth.

horrors.name: Pennywise
horrors.line: A red balloon floats up out of a storm drain. A clown with yellow eyes peeks out after it.

horrors.name: Nemesis
horrors.line: A huge figure in a trench coat smashes through the wall, a rocket launcher on its shoulder. It only has one word for a delver.

horrors.name: the Predator
horrors.line: Three red laser dots appear on a delver's chest. The jungle shimmers, and something invisible clicks.

horrors.name: the Lead Cenobite
horrors.line: A puzzle box clicks open. Chains rattle from nowhere, and a pale man with pins in his face steps out.

horrors.name: the Witch
horrors.line: A girl is crying in the dark. All the lights are off. a delver should not startle her.

horrors.name: the Shambler
horrors.line: The campfire hisses, and something with too many tentacles rises from the dark. The Shambler has come.

horrors.name: Amygdala
horrors.line: A huge spider-like thing with six arms and a face full of eyes clings to the cathedral walls.

horrors.name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
horrors.line: A swordswoman with a prosthetic arm and a winged helm rises from the lake of rot. She has never known defeat.

horrors.name: Shelob
horrors.line: The air grows thick with webs. A huge spider with a thousand eyes drops from the darkness.

horrors.name: the Leshen
horrors.line: The forest goes silent. A towering figure with antlers and a deer skull rises from the roots.

horrors.name: Count Dracula
horrors.line: A tall, pale nobleman in a cape steps out of the mist. He bids a delver welcome.

horrors.name: the Wendigo
horrors.line: The snow stops falling. A gaunt figure with antlers and a mouth of broken teeth steps out of the trees.

horrors.name: the Xenomorph Queen
horrors.line: The hive shakes. A colossal Xenomorph Queen rises from her egg sac, crest spreading, and screams at the congregation.

horrors.name: the Hive Mind
horrors.line: The whole colony groans. A titanic Necromorph, a mountain of flesh and tentacles, rises from the ice.

horrors.name: the Balrog of Moria
horrors.line: The stone bridge trembles. A demon of shadow and flame rises, its burning wings spreading.

horrors.name: Alduin the World-Eater
horrors.line: The sky splits open. A huge black dragon with burning red eyes descends from Sovngarde.

horrors.name: the Cyberdemon
horrors.line: The floor shakes. A towering demon with a rocket launcher for an arm and metal hooves stomps into view.

horrors.name: Diablo, Lord of Terror
horrors.line: Hellfire erupts. A huge red demon with horns and spines rises from the abyss. Diablo has come.

horrors.name: the Moon Presence
horrors.line: A blood moon fills the sky. A huge pale creature with tentacles and a long, thin face descends on the congregation.

horrors.name: the Heart of Darkness
horrors.line: The cavern pulses. A titanic, glowing heart, the size of a cathedral, beats deep beneath the manor.

horrors.name: Mr. X
horrors.line: Heavy footsteps echo through the precinct. A towering figure in a grey trench coat and fedora ducks through the doorway and fixes his eyes on the congregation.

horrors.name: Jason Voorhees
horrors.line: Mist rolls in off the lake. A big man in a hockey mask steps out of the treeline, machete in hand, and the cabin lights go out one by one.

horrors.name: the Headless Horseman
horrors.line: Hoofbeats on the bridge. A black rider without a head gallops out of the hollow, a flaming pumpkin raised in his fist.

horrors.name: Baba Yaga
horrors.line: The forest parts. A hut on giant chicken legs stalks into the clearing, turns, and kneels. A crone with iron teeth climbs out of her mortar.

horrors.name: Spring-Heeled Jack
horrors.line: A laugh echoes off the rooftops. A tall figure in a black cloak lands in the street on springs where its feet should be, eyes like red-hot coals.

horrors.name: the Black Shuck
horrors.line: A dog the size of a calf pads out of the churchyard fog, one burning eye in its head.

weapons.name: the Silver Key of the Dreamlands
the Star-Stone of Mnar
weapons.wielder: Nodens, Lord of the Great Abyss

weapons.name: Rakuyo
weapons.wielder: Lady Maria of the Astral Clocktower

weapons.name: the Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch
